lead.headline: Warren loses Rodgers; Footballers take Tuten's backup
lead.deck: Claims are done. Pittsburgh start Rudolph on Friday and ESPN has not repriced it; Tuten is a weekend call.
lead.body: Bad news first. Pittsburgh benched Aaron Rodgers overnight and Mason Rudolph starts against Denver on Friday; Warren's 14.8 has not moved since. Forbes now says sit him, and NBC expects the Steelers to run more. Tuten's ankle is a high sprain he has carried since Week 8. Coen will watch Wednesday and Thursday and said only 'We'll see'. At 02:11 Footballers claimed Chris Rodriguez Jr., the back who starts if Tuten sits. The lineup is still the projection lineup, and ESPN calls it 50-50. Two checks are left: Warren's number before Friday 14:00, and Tuten at 10:30 Sunday.

players.caption: Rudolph starts Friday; ESPN has not repriced him.

doFirst.headline: One decision, made in advance
doFirst.note: Claims processed overnight; nothing to claim. Watch Warren's projection before Friday 14:00 — if it drops below Diggs' 12.7, take the projection.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to move this morning: the lineup is the projection lineup.

cards.headline: Tuten: start if active
cards.reason: High ankle sprain since Week 8; Coen: 'We'll see'. Footballers now hold Rodriguez.
rows: Etienne into RB — or Gordon to RB and Diggs to FLEX (+0.7, coin flip: take Diggs)

roster.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup (128.6); Tuten is conditional. Warren's quarterback changed overnight and ESPN has not repriced him.

wire.headline: Nothing worth adding
wire.deck: Antonio Williams cleared to free agency with a real role and no seat. Every newcomer to the screen passes.

cannotSee.body: Jacksonville's first practice report is Wednesday afternoon, after this brief. Coen tied the decision to Wednesday and Thursday. The fallback is set in advance.

cannotSee.label: Warren's price
cannotSee.body: Rudolph's start broke about 04:00 UTC; Warren (14.8), Metcalf (9.6) and the Steelers D/ST (6.8) are unchanged in every snapshot since. ESPN may reprice before Friday 14:00 — the projection, once it moves, sets the slot.

cannotSee.label: Footballers' lineup
cannotSee.body: Mahomes (17.5) still sits behind Caleb Williams (16.0); Bowers (15.2) is questionable for Sunday night and they now roster Chris Rodriguez Jr. ESPN's 50% assumes the lineup as set.

cannotSee.label: Pending claims
cannotSee.body: Claims processed at 02:11 CDMX; AVIATO made none. Rivals' claims are invisible. Hockenson and Shrader are on waivers until Thursday 02:00 CDMX.

cannotSee.label: Matchup grades
cannotSee.body: From statpro.io season PPR points allowed per game, researched Tuesday 07:00. No game has been played since, so the ranks stand. Kicker and D/ST are not graded.

cannotSee.label: Kicker and D/ST
cannotSee.body: Fairbairn 9.3 vs Szmyt 10.3, Zvada 9.9: hold. Steelers 6.8 vs Cowboys 8.6, Chargers 8.2: a 1.8 gap, under the bar for a stream, so hold. The Insights page's market chip may say SWAP on the raw numbers; this is the call.

cannotSee.label: Trades
cannotSee.body: None proposed. The deadline is 2 Dec. At 4-7 the playoff path is narrow, and this run priced no two-way offer.
